statement: Revit 2027 includes a dockable AI assistant panel that answers how-to questions, queries the model and carries out model changes from natural-language prompts, using MCP-based tools.
superiority: Run assistant actions as reviewable, undoable command batches with a visible plan before execution.

acceptance.sketch: A natural-language request to list levels returns the project's level names.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Assistant covers contextual help, model query and modification; only the separate Revit Public MCP Server is labeled Tech Preview.

statement: Ask the assistant for model information such as element counts, parameters and room areas.
superiority: Answers cite the elements and queries used so they can be verified.

acceptance.sketch: Returned counts equal the schedule counts on a seeded model.

statement: Ask the assistant to change parameters or create elements through tool calls.
superiority: Preview every edit as a diff with per-edit approval.

acceptance.sketch: Requested parameter change is applied to the right elements and can be undone.

statement: AI suggests and places typical room elements (fixtures, furniture, devices) from room context.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Autocomplete Room Elements

superiority: Suggestions rank with reasons and respect clearances and code rules.

acceptance.sketch: Suggested set for a bathroom contains the expected fixture types.

notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: No help page found describing AI suggestion/placement of room elements. Tried: autocomplete, room layout generative, place furniture suggestions rooms, AI generated suggest, project intelligence, --api autocomplete room (only Dynamo Node Autocomplete).

statement: AI-assisted placement of tags and dimensions to reduce overlaps and clutter.
superiority: Deterministic layout engine with explainable constraints.

acceptance.sketch: Tag overlap count falls on a sample view versus manual placement.

notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: No help page found for AI-optimized tag/dimension placement. Tried: optimized annotations, tag overlap automatic placement, annotation clutter, project intelligence; only generic Tag on Placement and rebar annotation auto-placement exist.

statement: Through natural-language prompts the assistant can create floor plans, apply view templates, tag rooms, create sheets, place views and export PDFs.
superiority: Rule-based and reviewable generation with a repeatable result.

acceptance.sketch: A sheet set generated for a sample house includes plans, sections and schedules.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Documented via Assistant example workflow; 'project intelligence' branding not found in help.

statement: Expose Revit operations to external agents through the Model Context Protocol.
superiority: Provide an open MCP server with scoped permissions and audit log.

acceptance.sketch: An external client lists tools and runs a read-only query.

statement: Assistant actions are traceable: runs are logged in the Revit journal, AI-driven changes are labeled as undoable steps, and a Stop control lets the user interrupt a running request.

source.ref: New in Autodesk Assistant in Revit

superiority: Provide full provenance for each AI action in the history.

acceptance.sketch: Rolling back an AI change restores the earlier state exactly.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Documented traceability is journal logging, labeled undo entries and a Stop button; preview-and-rollback transactions not documented.
